prompt: The corner lot looks nicer than (we / expect) after neighbours planted flowers.
explanation_ru: После союза than идёт придаточное предложение с подлежащим и глаголом в прошедшем времени (we expected / we had expected).

prompt: The harbour officer found Carl's lost bag much faster ___ expected.
explanation_ru: После сравнительной степени (faster) используется союз than, а не then («затем») и не that.

prompt: Up close, the satellite model looks quite (different) the pictures in our book.
explanation_ru: В британском английском после прилагательного different используется предлог from (или to).

prompt: Putting up the kitchen shelf took much longer then Clement planned.
answer: Putting up the kitchen shelf took much longer than Clement planned.
accepted_answers: Putting up the kitchen shelf took much longer than Clement planned.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — путать союз сравнения than («чем») с наречием времени then («потом»).

prompt: Didn't you laugh much louder at that old farm film than (I / do)?
explanation_ru: После than для сравнения с действием в Past Simple (Didn't you laugh) используется вспомогательный глагол did (than I did).

prompt: I stopped at a tiny cave bakery in Matera for a cheap loaf of bread. The crust was far crisper (than / expect), and the bread tasted better than anything at our hotel. Its price was (similar) a plain supermarket roll back home. In fact, we paid (less / three) euros for the whole loaf!
explanation_ru: Устойчивый оборот — than expected; после similar ставится предлог to; перед числительным используется конструкция less than + число.

prompt: Jurgen expected two guests, but (more / fifteen) regular customers came to celebrate.
explanation_ru: Перед числительным «больше пятнадцати» передаётся конструкцией more than fifteen.

prompt: Ciara thought the new dental clinic would feel cold and scary, but it felt warm and calm.
options: The clinic was much friendlier than Ciara thought.
The clinic was much friendlier then Ciara thought.
The clinic was more friendly as Ciara thought.
The clinic was the same like the old scary one.
explanation_ru: После сравнительной степени friendlier нужен союз than; варианты с then, as и the same like содержат типичные ошибки.

prompt: Although Giulio hoped to uncover shiny silver coins at Ostia, the old clay spoon he found turned out to be far more interesting to visitors than (he / imagine).
explanation_ru: После than идёт придаточное предложение о более раннем ожидании — he had imagined (также допустимо he imagined).

prompt: My room in Rovinj wasn't cramped at all; the balcony was actually much quieter than (they / show) in the photos.
explanation_ru: После than ставится полное придаточное предложение в прошедшем времени (they showed / they had shown).

prompt: Dan's job interview at the garden cafe was completely different ___ the strict technical test he had prepared for.
explanation_ru: Прилагательное different сочетается с предлогом from (different from), а не с as, of или with.

prompt: We took our children to the cheese museum in Gouda on Saturday. It was much more fun than (we / think) it would be. A friendly guide let our kids weigh real cheeses on old wooden scales. My younger son enjoyed it even more than (his sister / do).
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске после than нужно прошедшее время we thought; во втором вспомогательный глагол did заменяет глагол enjoyed в Past Simple.

prompt: The visiting violin teacher jokes much more than (you / tell) me, Pia!
explanation_ru: После союза than идёт придаточное предложение в Past Simple (you told), чтобы сравнить реальность с прежними словами.

prompt: The new reading room is not like the grey old classroom at all. → The new reading room is completely …
answer: The new reading room is completely different from the grey old classroom.
accepted_answers: The new reading room is completely different from the grey old classroom.
The new reading room is completely different to the grey old classroom.
The new reading room is completely different from the old grey classroom.
The new reading room is completely different to the old grey classroom.
explanation_ru: Смысл not like передаётся конструкцией different from (в британском английском также возможно different to).

prompt: Through the small telescope in Sedona, we counted (more / twenty) bright craters on the moon.
explanation_ru: Перед числом используется связка more than + числительное (more than twenty).

prompt: The wooden shelf that arrived in the post wasn't the same size like the one in the online photo.
answer: The wooden shelf that arrived in the post wasn't the same size as the one in the online photo.
accepted_answers: The wooden shelf that arrived in the post wasn't the same size as the one in the online photo.
explanation_ru: После the same всегда используется союз as (the same ... as), а не like.

prompt: Bongani joined the early charity fun run along the beach in Port Elizabeth. Thanks to cheerful drummers near the tower, the final stretch felt easier than (he / fear). The route was (similar) a park jog rather than a hard race. In fact, Bongani finished three minutes sooner than (his cousin / can).
explanation_ru: После than ставится придаточное в прошедшем времени (he feared, his cousin could), а прилагательное similar требует предлога to.

prompt: Nobody in our group expected the retired nurses to finish faster ___.
explanation_ru: После than перед глаголом did требуется подлежащая форма местоимения we (than we did), а не us и не союз then/as.

prompt: After reading worried travel posts online, Daichi found that boarding the mountain bus in Takayama was far simpler than (online posts / suggest).
explanation_ru: Придаточное после than описывает прежнее впечатление из отзывов, поэтому используется Past Perfect (had suggested) или Past Simple (suggested).

prompt: Why is the paid bag-drop queue moving slower than (the free one / be) right beside us?
explanation_ru: Во второй части сравнения вспомогательный глагол повторяет время главного предложения (is moving → the free one is).

prompt: Hi Mum, I just finished my first history presentation at Aberystwyth University. It went much better (than / plan), and everyone clapped at the end. My classmates asked far more questions than (I / be) ready for, all about the old town map! The whole seminar felt (different) our quiet school lessons back home.
explanation_ru: После сравнительной степени используются сокращённый оборот than planned и придаточное than I was; после different ставится предлог from (или to).

prompt: The weather forecast promised cold rain on the mountain path, but Bryn enjoyed clear blue skies all afternoon.
options: The mountain weather was much better then the forecast had promised.
The mountain weather was different as what the forecast had promised.
The mountain weather was more warm than expected it.
The mountain weather was much better than the forecast had promised.
explanation_ru: Правильное сравнение строится с союзом than и полным придаточным (than the forecast had promised); в других вариантах ошибки then, different as и лишнее it.

prompt: Ruta walked into her new harbour office in Kaunas expecting a quiet, awkward first Monday. Instead, her desk was decorated with bright paper stars and a slice of warm apple cake. Her colleagues made her feel far more welcome than (she / dare) to hope. The friendly atmosphere wasn't (same) her previous, strict workplace at all. It took (less / ten) minutes for her nerves to disappear.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске после than стоит придаточное (she had dared); во втором — устойчивая связка the same as; перед числом минут используется less than ten.

prompt: Antoine expected the pine bookcase to take an hour to build, not three hours. → The pine bookcase took two hours longer …
answer: The pine bookcase took two hours longer than Antoine expected.
accepted_answers: The pine bookcase took two hours longer than Antoine expected.
The pine bookcase took two hours longer than Antoine had expected.
The pine bookcase took two hours longer than expected.
explanation_ru: После сравнительной степени longer вводится придаточное ожидания через союз than (than Antoine expected / had expected).

prompt: Xavier admitted that the little documentary about olive farms was far funnier than anyone in the courtyard had anticipated.
answer: Xavier admitted that the little documentary about olive farms was far funnier than anyone in the courtyard had anticipated.
accepted_answers: Xavier admitted that the little documentary about olive farms was far funnier than anyone in the courtyard had anticipated.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: союз than верно вводит придаточное предложение в Past Perfect (had anticipated).

prompt: Horst had only booked a quiet table for two in Koblenz, so seeing twenty former pupils in gold paper hats meant far more to him than (anyone / know).
explanation_ru: После сравнительного оборота more ... than следует придаточное предложение в прошедшем времени (anyone knew / anyone had known).

prompt: Unlike the quiet galleries we visited earlier that week, the interactive art museum in Enschede kept our children busy far longer ___.
explanation_ru: После сравнительной степени longer нужен союз than и подходящее по смыслу придаточное had expected; then и as здесь ошибочны.

prompt: Wiebke was terrified before the rehearsal with the visiting conductor in Gottingen. Older players had warned her he was strict, but he acted much warmer than (they / describe). He didn't treat teenagers (same) professional orchestra members, and he laughed through the warm-up. In the end, nobody in the cello section left the hall smiling wider than (she)!
explanation_ru: После than используются придаточное they had described и местоимение в объектном падеже her (в более формальном стиле — she did); сравнение тождества требует the same as.
